decision.explanation: From the original sources, two distinct positions are attributed to Ernest Leo Unterkoefler. Document D1S3 explicitly states that he has been appointed as the leader of the country's second-largest political party. Document D2S2 confirms that he holds the position of auxiliary bishop. These are separate roles and do not conflict, as they pertain to different domains (political leadership and ecclesiastical service). Both are valid and supported by direct textual evidence.
